messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] spike in 5xx for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (p95 latency increased). Auto-paging to #incidents and @oncall.

Jonas Meyer: Oncall here, taking it. Sharing obs links and grabbing logs.

Jonas Meyer: Traces: https://obs.redwood.internal/trace/ef12b34c

Maya Chen: Joining. Any idea which pools/nodes are hit? is this one-off or multiple hosts?

Luca Rossi: Initial read shows pool-eu-embeds-7 has elevated kernel stalls on 2 hosts. A few retries causing contention.

Luca Rossi: Customers routed through that pool: Veridian Bank (dedicated), ApexTravel (dedicated), HelioHealth (hosted heavy). Also several lower-tier hosted tenants.

Aisha Bello: @CSM_Maria — FYI Veridian legal is strict about SLA language. If we need to send tailored comms I can draft.

Jonas Meyer: Mitigation plan: 1) cordon suspicious hosts, 2) rolling restart remaining pool members, 3) increase fallback routing to eu-north, 4) apply temporary embed-route throttle to reduce retry amplification.

OpsBot: ACTION started: cordon host host-07-eu (by jonas.m) - run id r-20240411-77z

Maya Chen: Kicking off restart of pool-eu-embeds-7 (graceful). Will monitor KV cache warmup.

Luca Rossi: Observing partial recovery on restarted nodes. Error rate down ~60% but p95 still elevated.

Maria Gomez: Draft for Veridian Bank (short, customer-facing):

```
Veridian Bank — We are investigating degraded embeddings performance in eu-west-1 which may cause delays or occasional failures for background embeddings jobs. Engineers are actively mitigating (rolling restarts and regional fallback). We expect improved stability within 15–35 minutes. A post-incident summary will follow; we will not issue any credit statements until the incident review completes.
```

Aisha Bello: That reads well. I'll hold on credits language as requested.

Jonas Meyer: Status page draft (will post after review):

```
Short summary: We are seeing increased errors and latency for embeddings in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of customers. Mitigation underway: host cordon, rolling restarts, and traffic fallback to eu-north.
Impact: Some customers may experience 5xx errors or delayed embeddings. We are not seeing any customer data exposure.
What we're doing: cordoning affected hosts, restarting instances, migrating traffic, and throttling to prevent retry storms.
ETA: preliminary stabilization expected in 15–35 minutes. Updates every 10–15 minutes.
```

Maya Chen: Small change: make ETA 12–30 mins and add that we're monitoring KV cache warmup for impacted models.

Jonas Meyer: Updated.

Luca Rossi: Ops checklist: run /opt/redwood/bin/check_embeddings.sh, confirm fallback routes, verify KV cache for Veridian models warmed on fallback.

Jonas Meyer: Healthcheck output: 3/4 nodes healthy after restart, fallback to eu-north at ~96% success rate.

incident-bot: NOTE: escalation to #oncall-lead after 18 minutes no full resolution.

Ravi Patel: Oncall lead here. Any deploys around start time?

Maya Chen: No deploys in eu-west-1 in prior 90 minutes. Telemetry points to host-level IO stalls on host-07-eu -> initiating hardware ticket.

Luca Rossi: Action: migrate Veridian traffic off host-07-eu and keep it cordoned for hardware triage. Continue restarts for remaining pool nodes.

Jonas Meyer: Preparing customer routing snippet for support ops:
- Veridian Bank — contacts: infra-alerts@veridian.com ; veridian-sre@veridian.com — route: Dedicated pool-eu-embeds-7 (migrated to fallback)
- ApexTravel — contacts: ops@apextravel.com — route: Dedicated pool-eu-embeds-5 (monitoring)
- HelioHealth — contacts: platform@helio.health — route: Hosted (auto-fallback eu-north)

Maria Gomez: Internal CSM template for accounts:

"Quick update: We are mitigating an embeddings performance issue in eu-west-1 that may cause delays or transient failures. Engineers expect improved stability in 12–30 minutes. For urgent production impact, reply here and we'll prioritize a support call. We'll send a detailed incident report afterwards."

Aisha Bello: Sending to Veridian now and tagging Jonas for technical follow-ups.

Maya Chen: Rolling restart finished for pool-eu-embeds-7. host-07-eu cordoned; host-09-eu passed healthchecks and is back in rotation.

Luca Rossi: p95 errors down ~88% in last 10 minutes. Still keeping throttles in place for another 10 minutes while caches warm.

incident-bot: STATUS update recorded at 2024-04-11T07:18:20Z (pending status page post-review).

Jonas Meyer: We'll keep this thread for final timeline and post-incident summary. I'll attach logs and exact timeline when the incident is closed.

Ravi Patel: Good work — leave the cordoned host in triage and schedule a post-incident review tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Jonas Meyer: Closing notes: stabilized, monitoring for 15 more minutes then preparing PIR. Thanks everyone."
